# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 18 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 18 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_018_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 18

**18:1** He found a cave close by and got Mary settled inside it. He asked his sons to stay with her and set out to look for a Hebrew midwife somewhere in the Bethlehem region.

**18:2** This is where I, Joseph, must speak in my own voice. I was walking — or so it seemed. But I was also somehow not walking at all. I lifted my eyes to the sky and the sky had stopped. It hung there, utterly still. The air around me was arrested in a kind of amazement. The birds overhead were fixed in space, mid-flight, as if nailed there. I looked down: a bowl sat on the ground, workers reclining around it, hands resting in it — and no one was eating. No one was moving. Someone had been lifting something; his arms stayed up. Someone was raising food to his lips; his hand never arrived. Every single face was tilted upward, frozen in the same direction.

**18:3** A shepherd had his arm raised to drive his flock, but the flock was a painting and the arm never came down. At a stream nearby, a cluster of goat-kids had their mouths at the water — and weren't drinking. And then, like a held breath finally released, the whole world moved again at once.

**18:4** Just then a woman came picking her way down the hillside toward me. "Where are you headed?" she asked. "I'm looking for a Hebrew midwife," I said. "Are you Israelite?" she asked. "I am." "Who is the woman in labor in that cave?" I told her she was my betrothed. "Not your wife?" she pressed. I explained: "Her name is Mary. She was raised in the temple of the Lord. The priests gave her to me as a wife — but she is not my wife. What is in her was conceived by the Holy Spirit."

**18:5** "Is that really true?" the midwife asked. "Come and see for yourself," Joseph answered. And she came with him.
